definition: a small tough horse of the old west
description: A herd of horses runs through a shallow river in a red desert canyon. At the front a laughing young woman with a long black braid, in a denim shirt and jeans, rides barefoot and bareback on a buckskin horse straight towards the front, water splashing up around its legs. Dozens of brown, grey and white horses gallop behind her, kicking up dust and water in the golden evening light. People stand at a wooden corral fence in the background under a huge sandstone rock.

en.question: What is the young woman doing?

de.answer: Sie reitet ein Pony durch den Fluss.
de.question: Was macht die junge Frau?

es.answer: Está montando un poni por el río.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la joven?

fr.answer: Elle traverse la rivière sur un poney.
fr.question: Que fait la jeune femme ?
